name: n8n Content Research
description: Content research workflow inside n8n. Runs a Tavily web search and summarizes the results for downstream content drafting. Low sensitivity because the result set is public web content and no write paths are exposed.

skills.name: Tavily Search
skills.description: Runs a Tavily web search with depth (basic or advanced) and returns scored results.

skills.name: Content Summarize
skills.description: Summarizes a result set into a paragraph suitable for downstream drafting.
